reason: The README clearly describes a DSH bridge to MiniMax services, centered on API-backed multimodal understanding and media generation with supplementary search, quota, CLI environment management, and local output caching.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 MiniMax，为对话提供图片理解、图像与视频生成、语音和音乐生成、搜索及用量查询能力。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to MiniMax to provide image understanding, image and video generation, speech and music generation, search, and quota queries.

capabilities: Calls the MiniMax service through mmx-cli for image understanding and generation, video generation, speech synthesis, music generation, audio cover generation, web search, and quota queries
Reads image attachments and writes generated media and image-recognition cache files to a temporary output directory
Can execute mmx-cli environment operations including discovery, global installation, API-key login, authentication status checks, and path configuration
